author: RayyianAtique
quote: The game has the worse mechanics and visuals, such as getting drinks out of no where at fridge. The animations are broken, there are easy-to-do glitches as well. The game mechanics are super broken such as no-clipping at crates and stuff like that. Even if you have the PS5 Pro it`s capped at 30FPS. Why this big game doesn`t use the full performance of the device even? The characters suddenly change when you go from doors as well, there is so many to fix and re build it. Even it got scheduled but there is still big problems and glitches.
